headerDisplay: Hikvision doorbell plugin for Homebridge: RTSP video/audio, HomeKit Doorbell events, HomeKit Secure Video, and two-way audio through HCNetSDK.

did.title: Stable Accessory ID
did.description: Any stable unique ID for this Homebridge accessory. It is not sent to Hikvision.

model.title: Model
model.description: Displayed in Apple Home accessory information.

ip.title: Doorbell IP Address
ip.description: Local LAN address of the Hikvision outdoor station.

username.title: Device Username
username.description: Hikvision device username used by local integrations.

password.title: Device Password
password.description: Hikvision device password used by local integrations. Keep this private.

rtspUrl.title: RTSP URL
rtspUrl.description: Direct RTSP URL used for HomeKit live video/audio, for example rtsp://user:password@192.168.1.50/Streaming/Channels/101. Keep credentials private.

doorbellService.title: Doorbell Service
doorbellService.description: Expose this accessory as a real HomeKit Doorbell camera.

hikConnectDoorbell.title: Hik-Connect Doorbell Events
hikConnectDoorbell.description: Use the Hik-Connect account credentials below to detect incoming calls from the indoor station and trigger the HomeKit Doorbell notification.

hikConnectUsername.title: Hik-Connect Username
hikConnectUsername.description: Hik-Connect account username used only for doorbell call-state polling.

hikConnectPassword.title: Hik-Connect Password
hikConnectPassword.description: Hik-Connect account password. Stored in Homebridge config like the device password.

hikConnectBaseUrl.title: Hik-Connect API Base URL
hikConnectBaseUrl.description: Leave default unless your Hik-Connect account is assigned to a different regional API host.

indoorStationSerial.title: Indoor Station Serial
indoorStationSerial.description: Serial number of the indoor panel that receives the doorbell call, for example DS-KH6310-W.

hikConnectPollIntervalMs.title: Hik-Connect Call Poll Interval (ms)
hikConnectPollIntervalMs.description: Calls are deduplicated by state. Startup and recovery after a long interruption establish a baseline without creating a ring event.

doorbellAnswerOnStreamStart.title: Treat Live View as Doorbell Answer
doorbellAnswerOnStreamStart.description: Treat opening the HomeKit live stream shortly after a doorbell ring as answering that call and suppress duplicate rings.

hikConnectAnswerOnStreamStart.title: Answer Hik-Connect Call on Live View
hikConnectAnswerOnStreamStart.description: Also send a Hik-Connect CallSignal answer command when HomeKit live view opens after a Hik-Connect ring. Experimental; useful when the indoor panel keeps ringing and blocks talkback.

doorbellAnswerWindowMs.title: Doorbell Answer Window (ms)
doorbellAnswerWindowMs.description: How long after a ring a HomeKit live stream start is treated as answering that doorbell call.

doorbellSuppressAfterAnswerMs.title: Doorbell Suppress After Answer (ms)
doorbellSuppressAfterAnswerMs.description: How long to suppress additional doorbell events after the live stream answers the call, unless Hik-Connect reports idle earlier.

audio.title: Enable Audio
audio.description: Enable Hikvision RTSP microphone audio for Apple Home live view.

twoWayAudio.title: Two-Way Audio
twoWayAudio.description: Enable HomeKit Talk. For this Hikvision doorbell use the HCNetSDK transport.

talkbackTransport.title: Talkback Transport
talkbackTransport.description: Speaker transport for HomeKit Talk. Use hcnet-sdk for the Hikvision doorbell.

hcnetSdkLibrary.title: HCNetSDK Library
hcnetSdkLibrary.description: Path to libhcnetsdk.so on the Homebridge host/container. Keep SDK binaries outside this repository.

hcnetSdkComponentPath.title: HCNetSDK Component Directory
hcnetSdkComponentPath.description: Path to the HCNetSDKCom directory that belongs to the installed HCNetSDK runtime.

hsv.title: HomeKit Secure Video
hsv.description: Enable HomeKit Secure Video support for this camera.

motionSensor.title: Expose Motion Sensor
motionSensor.description: Expose motion events from the doorbell as a HomeKit Motion Sensor.

nativeEvents.title: Native HCNetSDK Events
nativeEvents.description: Subscribe to local HCNetSDK alarm callbacks for supported device events such as motion.

localHttpApi.title: Local HTTP API
localHttpApi.description: Optional private LAN helper API for diagnostics and manual local triggers. Most users can leave this disabled.

localHttpToken.title: Local HTTP API Token
localHttpToken.description: Optional bearer token for local control/stream endpoints. Use Authorization: Bearer <token> or ?token=. Read-only status endpoints never expose this value.

ffmpeg.title: FFmpeg Path
ffmpeg.description: Optional ffmpeg binary path. Leave empty to use Homebridge ffmpeg.
